note: On-screen content only. Spoken scripts live in the 'DayXero Program Scripts v2' doc and arrive later as audio files. Any user-facing string may be a variant object keyed default / smoking / vaping / pouches (and nrt where noted). See DAYXERO_PROGRAM_HANDOFF.md section 2.

phases.title: Prep
phases.subtitle: Learn your habit. Keep using as normal.

sessions.label: Prep 1
sessions.title: You don't have to quit today
sessions.subtitle: How the prep week works

lines: At your current pace, that's about {yearly_units} {unit_plural} a year.
You're about to take that back.

beats.prompt: Your reasons. Anything to add?
Which one matters most?
A lot of the relief from nicotine comes from…

options.text: It adds something extra that non-users don't have
It settles the restlessness left by the last dose

beats.feedback: Right. That's the battery. You'll start spotting it everywhere this week.

beats.text: Hold to commit to your Quit Day: {quit_date}

mission.text: Log every use today. Before three of them, ask: do I want this, or is my battery just low?

sessions.completionText: First prep day done. You didn't have to change a thing. Just notice.

sessions.label: Prep 2
sessions.title: The first one of the day
sessions.subtitle: Loosen the morning routine

beats.prompt: Which moment will you put a gap after?
beats.feedback: Set. We'll remind you in the morning.

beats.prompt: How automatic does your first one of the day feel?
Why does the first one of the day often feel strongest?

options.text: The level drops overnight, so the first top-up is felt most
Mornings are always the most stressful time

beats.feedback: Exactly. Which is why a small gap here teaches your brain so much.

mission.text: Put a 15-minute gap (or 5, if that's what feels doable) between your morning moment and your first nicotine. Log how long you managed.

sessions.completionText: Tomorrow morning: one small gap. That's all.

sessions.label: Prep 3
sessions.title: Use with your eyes open
sessions.subtitle: One session, full attention
sessions.listenHint: Best heard just before you'd use anyway.

beats.prompt: How good do you expect your next one to feel?

mission.text: Do one session today with no phone and full attention, then log what you noticed.

followUp.prompt: How good did it actually feel?

pouches.text: Already thinking about the next one

followUp.feedback: Thanks for being honest. Every answer is useful, including the parts you liked.

sessions.completionText: You looked at it with your eyes open. That's rare.

sessions.label: Prep 4
sessions.title: The stress loop
sessions.subtitle: A breath that works in the moment

beats.prompt: How tense do you feel right now?
And now?

beats.label: Two more sighs, with the ring.

cards.back: It settles the restlessness that builds between doses. The stress itself is still there.

cards.front: “I need it when things get hard”
cards.back: You need a break when things get hard. You can keep the break.
It can feel that way in the first days. Over time, many people who quit feel calmer than before.

mission.text: When stress hits today, do two sighs first. Then use if you still want to. Log whether you did.

sessions.completionText: You've got a breath for stress now. Use it first.

sessions.label: Prep 5
sessions.title: Riding the wave
sessions.subtitle: The skill that matters most

beats.label: Try one now, even without a craving.

beats.prompt: If you don't use, a craving…

options.text: Keeps growing until you give in
Rises, peaks and fades, usually within a few minutes

beats.feedback: That's it. Every wave breaks. Your job is just to stay on the board.

beats.prompt: Where do you usually feel a craving?
beats.feedback: Knowing your early signal means you'll catch the wave sooner.

mission.text: Surf one craving for three minutes with Craving SOS before you use. Afterwards, rate its peak from 0 to 10.

sessions.completionText: You know how to ride the wave. That's the big one.

sessions.label: Prep 6
sessions.title: Make it easy on yourself
sessions.subtitle: Set up your space and your support

smoking: Pack and lighter out of my pocket

beats.title: Your quit kit
items: All of it where nicotine used to live

pouches.text: Step down my pouch strength first

beats.safetyText: Follow the product label. If you're pregnant, have a heart condition or take other medicines, check with a pharmacist or doctor first.

beats.prefill: Heads up: I'm quitting nicotine in two days. If I'm a bit cranky, that's why. A message from you would really help.

mission.text: Move your nicotine to one inconvenient spot, and put your quit kit where it used to be.

sessions.completionText: Your space is set up. Willpower gets a day off.

sessions.label: Prep 7
sessions.title: The night before
sessions.subtitle: Clear out and get ready

vaping: Vapes and pods handed over or set aside for battery recycling

footer.vaping: Vapes have batteries. Please don't put them in the bin. Take them to a battery or electronics recycling point.

beats.prompt: Write one line to tomorrow-you.

beats.text: Hold when you're ready for Day Xero.

mission.text: Make your last use a conscious one, then clear everything out.

sessions.completionText: Everything's ready. Tomorrow is Day Xero.

sessions.label: Day Xero
sessions.title: Day Xero
sessions.subtitle: Your first day

beats.title: What today might bring

cards.back: They come and go. Each one passes within minutes.
Take the day in small pieces.
Usually settles within a few weeks.

beats.footer: These are signs your body is adjusting. They're usually strongest in the first days and ease over 2 to 4 weeks.

beats.label: Your first breaths of Day Xero.

mission.text: Every craving you ride out today, tap “It passed”. Every single one counts.

sessions.completionText: You're on Day Xero. Your counter has started.

sessions.label: Day 2
sessions.title: Look after the basics
sessions.subtitle: Food, water, sleep

beats.prompt: Quick check-in
beats.feedback: Logged. You'll be able to watch these change over the coming days.

beats.prompt: When you're hungry between meals, what will you reach for?

mission.text: Three proper meals, water close by, and tap “It passed” after every craving you ride.

sessions.completionText: Day 2 done. Look after the basics, and the rest gets easier.

sessions.label: Day 3
sessions.title: The noisy passengers
sessions.subtitle: Let them talk. Keep driving.

beats.prompt: What do your loudest passengers say?
What do you say back, calmly, while you keep driving?
beats.placeholder: I hear you. Still not stopping.

beats.prompt: A loud craving thought shows up. The bus approach is to…

options.text: Argue with it until it stops
Let it talk, and keep driving
Pull over and give it what it wants

beats.feedback: Right. It can shout. It can't steer.

mission.text: Name one passenger today when it shows up.

sessions.completionText: They can shout. They can't drive.

sessions.label: Day 4
sessions.title: Lower the bar
sessions.subtitle: Getting through the toughest stretch

beats.prompt: If today gets hard, then I will…
How are you doing, honestly?
beats.feedback: Thanks for telling the truth. Wherever you are today is fine.

mission.text: Do one thing that moves your body today, even for five minutes.

sessions.completionText: You're through the hump. It gets lighter from here.

sessions.label: Day 5
sessions.title: If things feel flat
sessions.subtitle: Small lifts that add up

beats.prompt: Pick three lifts for flat days.
beats.feedback: These are your lifts. We'll suggest them on flat days.

beats.prompt: How's your energy today?

mission.text: Do one of your lifts today, on purpose.

sessions.completionText: Flat days pass. Your lifts are saved.

sessions.label: Day 6
sessions.title: Nights out
sessions.subtitle: Plan it while you're clear-headed

beats.prompt: Someone offers you one at a party. You say…

options.feedback: Clear and done. That's the strongest answer.
That leaves later-you to deal with it. A clear no is kinder to yourself.
If it happens, it's a slip, not a reset. Log it and keep going.

beats.prompt: Your no-line, in your own words.
Pick three for your next night out.

options.text: Keep a drink in my hand
Stay away from where people use
Leave early if I need to

beats.footer: Alcohol makes slips more likely for many people, so plan ahead.

mission.text: Next time you're out, use your no-line at least once.

sessions.completionText: Your no-line is ready when you need it.

sessions.label: Day 7
sessions.title: “Just one”
sessions.subtitle: Play the tape forward

cards.back: Play the tape forward: one, then this weekend, then whenever I'm stressed.
Tomorrow-you gets a louder craving to deal with. Be kind to them.

beats.prompt: If you do have one, what happens to your progress in DayXero?

options.text: You have to start the program again
It stays. You log the slip and keep going

beats.feedback: Right. A slip is one moment, not a verdict.

beats.prompt: Play the tape forward. Where would “just one” take you?

mission.text: When “just one” shows up, play the tape forward before deciding anything.

sessions.completionText: You'll recognise “just one” now. That's half the battle.

sessions.label: Day 8
sessions.title: One week
sessions.subtitle: Look back, then look ahead

beats.prompt: What helped most this week?

mission.text: Tell one person you've done a week. Optional, but it feels good.

sessions.completionText: One week. Well done.

sessions.label: Day 9
sessions.title: The empty minutes
sessions.subtitle: Build a break menu

beats.prompt: Pick three for your break menu.
beats.feedback: Your break menu is saved. It'll show up on Craving SOS when boredom hits.

beats.prompt: How often does boredom bring on a craving right now?

mission.text: Take one proper break today from your menu.

sessions.completionText: Your break menu is ready for the empty minutes.

sessions.label: Day 11
sessions.title: Sleep and strange dreams
sessions.subtitle: Set up a wind-down

beats.prompt: You dreamt you used. What does it mean?
beats.feedback: Exactly. A dream isn't a slip. Let it go and start your day.

beats.prompt: Build your wind-down.
How's your sleep this week?

mission.text: Try your wind-down tonight. The 4-7-8 breath is in the Stress toolkit whenever you want it.

sessions.completionText: Your wind-down is set for tonight.

sessions.label: Day 15
sessions.title: Two weeks: what's changed
sessions.subtitle: Notice the quiet changes

beats.prompt: What have you noticed?

smoking.feedback: That's okay. A lot of change is quiet. Check again next week.

vaping.feedback: That's okay. A lot of change is quiet. Check again next week.

pouches.feedback: That's okay. A lot of change is quiet. Check again next week.

mission.text: Spend a little of the money you've kept on something small, just for you.

sessions.completionText: Two weeks. Keep going, it's working.

sessions.label: Day 17
sessions.title: When life gets heavy
sessions.subtitle: Make room for big feelings

beats.prompt: Think of something on your mind. How heavy does it feel?
And now?
Write a line to read on your hardest days.
beats.placeholder: This will pass. I don't need nicotine to get through it.

beats.prompt: If something big goes wrong, then I will…

beats.title: If it stays heavy
beats.body: If a heavy feeling stays with you for weeks, talking to a doctor or someone you trust can really help.

mission.text: Next time you feel something heavy, make room for it for 60 seconds before anything else.

sessions.completionText: Big feelings pass too. You can make room for them.

sessions.label: Day 20
sessions.title: Out of nowhere
sessions.subtitle: When an old cue fires

beats.prompt: A strong craving hits after you smell smoke. That means…

options.text: An old cue fired. Ride it and it'll fade
I should have one to get it over with

beats.feedback: Exactly. Old cue, same skill, and it gets smaller each time.

beats.prompt: Which cues could catch you off guard?

options.text: The shop where I used to buy

beats.feedback: Added to your plan. Knowing them is half the defence.

mission.text: If an out-of-nowhere craving hits, call it an old cue, out loud or in your head, and ride it.

sessions.completionText: Old cue, same skill. It gets smaller every time.

sessions.label: Day 22
sessions.title: Three weeks: you're rewiring
sessions.subtitle: Your toolkit so far

beats.prompt: Which tool has helped most so far?

mission.text: Tell someone one thing that's changed in three weeks.

sessions.completionText: Three weeks of rewiring. Your toolkit is all yours.

sessions.label: Day 25
sessions.title: Your body, moving forward
sessions.subtitle: Movement, appetite and next steps

beats.prompt: Pick a way to move this week.
beats.feedback: Saved. It'll show up on Craving SOS as an option.

beats.title: Plan your step-down
beats.body: Follow the step-down plan on your product's label. We'll remind you on each date.
beats.safetyText: Follow the product label. If you're pregnant, have a heart condition or take other medicines, check with a pharmacist or doctor first.

beats.prompt: A craving hits mid-afternoon. A quick way to help it pass is…

options.text: Sit still and wait for it to win
A few minutes of movement, like a brisk walk or the stairs

beats.feedback: Right. Moving changes the channel, and the wave passes.

mission.text: Next time a craving hits, try five minutes of movement first.

sessions.completionText: Moving is one more tool in your kit.

sessions.label: Day 28
sessions.title: If you ever slip
sessions.subtitle: The one-minute plan

beats.intro: Let's run through it once, so it feels familiar.
beats.outro: That's the whole debrief. One minute, then back on track.

cards.back: You haven't. Many people who quit for good slipped along the way.
That's the thought that turns a slip into a return. Stop here.

beats.prompt: After a slip, the most helpful thing is…

options.text: Finish what's left and start fresh on Monday
Stop, log it, and pick one thing to try next time
Start the program again from the beginning

beats.feedback: Exactly. One minute, then keep going.

mission.text: Nothing to do today. Just know the plan is there.

sessions.completionText: The slip plan is there if you ever need it. Nothing resets.

sessions.label: Day 31
sessions.title: Graduation
sessions.subtitle: “I don't use nicotine”

beats.prompt: Pick the line that's yours.
A short note to the you of Prep 1.

sessions.completionText: The program's done, but DayXero stays with you. Craving SOS, your plan and your milestones are always here.

sosTracks.title: Ride a big wave
sosTracks.subtitle: For a strong craving, right now

sosTracks.title: I just slipped
sosTracks.subtitle: One minute, then back on track
